profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Disney  | Swiftie | Proud Latina
profile.summary:
👋 Hi there! I'm Brenda, a Software Engineer passionate about building technology that creates meaningful impact and exceptional experiences.

💻 I enjoy solving complex problems, designing scalable solutions, and continuously learning in an industry that is always evolving. What drew me to software engineering is the unique combination of creativity and logic—transforming ideas into solutions that improve experiences for users and drive value for businesses.

🌟 As a proud Latina in tech, I value representation, continuous growth, and fostering environments where diverse perspectives can thrive. Throughout my career, I've had the opportunity to collaborate with talented teams, tackle challenging technical problems, and contribute to products that serve thousands of users.

☁️ My experience spans software development, cloud technologies, system integrations, and building reliable, scalable applications. I am passionate about leveraging technology not only to solve problems, but also to create experiences that make a lasting impact.

✨ I strive to approach both my work and life with curiosity, resilience, and a mindset best captured by one of my favorite Disney quotes: “No matter how your heart is grieving, if you keep on believing, the dream that you wish will come true.” 

Whether you want to talk about software engineering, technology, innovation, career growth, or a little Disney magic, let's connect!

positions.title: Security Software Engineer I
positions.description: Skills: DBeaver · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · FastAPI

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
• Wrote high-performing code resulting in improved production performance and maintained a performance drop of under 10% on code changes.
• Collaborated cross-functionally to consistently deliver high-quality software, ensuring fewer than 10 defects for QA teams and zero high-severity defects in production.
• Enforced and maintained policies, procedures, secure coding practices, and coding conventions associated with effective and efficient software development.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer in Test
positions.description: Skills: Cypress · Testrail · Regression Testing · Bug Tracking · MongoDB · JavaScript · Manual Testing · Postman · Automation · Test Planning

positions.title: Software Developer Engineer In Test Intern
positions.description:
• Assist in the development of end to end automated regression and performance test scripts 
• Work closely with development teams to ensure the effectiveness and quality of the components and systems developed
• Develop, maintain and execute test cases, ensuring the quality and stability of the system throughout the project
• Anticipate potential software problems by creating test scenarios.
• Identify and analyze defects/test results and be able to deduct the chain of events leading to a failure.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
• Create new, innovative solutions following best practices for performance and scalability
• Maintain and improve the functionality of existing applications
• Contribute to improvements of ongoing standard software development processes, team
infrastructure, and methodology in collaboration with other Software Engineers
• Ongoing review of development efforts to ensure compliance with business requirements,
scalability, security, and other best practices
• Maintain web-based applications and back-end services using the C#/.NET Framework and SQL
Server technologies
• Code front-end web pages using modern technologies (JQuery, CSS, Bootstrap responsive
layouts, JSON)

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
• Develop a brand-new administrative webpage for the employees to make everyday use of for the managing of
transactions, and other records in the office.
• Plan, design, write, and debug a web application with complete accuracy.
• Collaborate with team member to share tasks and optimize completion of project.
• Meet daily with manager to discuss the web application’s requirements to be added and assess the progress of the
application.
• Stylize the webpage to reflect attractive designs.
